title: When the Wardrobe Falls
author: Jonah Reyes
blurb: Orsen Thackeray, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
